description.en: A circumbinary giant planet around a pulsar-white dwarf pair in the globular cluster M4.
description.ru: Планета-гигант вокруг пары пульсар–белый карлик в шаровом скоплении M4.

gameplay: Условный пролёт в окружении шарового скопления

epoch.label: J2000.0 TDB (no catalogue reference times; phases assumed)
epoch.basis: common instant of every body state in this file

frame.axes: right-handed; x = sky-plane reference direction (node line), y = toward the observer (Earth), z = completes the right-handed set (sky-plane 'south' of the node). Edge-on orbits lie near the x-y plane.

notes.en: Newtonian point masses; no GR, tides, radiation pressure or gas hydrodynamics unless a module says so.
notes.ru: Ньютоновские точечные массы; без ОТО, приливов, давления излучения и газодинамики, если модуль не указан явно.

mass_kg.note: pulsar mass assumed in the cited timing model (not measured)

radius_m.note: canonical neutron-star radius ~11 km (not measured for this pulsar)

star.teff_k.note: surface thermal temperature illustrative; planets in the core are not heated by it unless a module adds spin-down power

appearance.method: colour = CIE-integrated blackbody of Teff; surface detail artistic

compact.spin_period_s.note: transcribed from the paper; re-verify before scenario validation

compact.spin_epoch_jd.note: epoch of the published spin period

compact.beam_axis.note: beam geometry is not reconstructed from timing; illustrative

compact.spin_down_power_w.note: order-of-magnitude spin-down power; not used as irradiation by default

compact.beam_power_fraction.note: share of the luminosity in the two rotation-averaged beams; order of radio efficiency (1e-2), illustrative

mass_kg.note: timing + optical constraints; transcribed from the paper, re-verify before scenario validation

appearance.method: colour = CIE-integrated blackbody of Teff; surface detail artistic

elements.period_s.note: inner P/e from the cited timing table

state.method: binary period/e from timing literature; inclination and phase assumed

radius_m.method: Chen & Kipping 2017 mean mass-radius relation (no scatter); astrophysical scatter is large from mass

elements.period_s.method: Kepler III from catalogue semi-major axis

elements.e.note: eccentricity not in default row; circular assumed

elements.omega_deg.note: unknown; 90 deg (transit at periapsis phase convention). Irrelevant for circular orbits

elements.node_deg.note: longitude of node is unconstrained by transits/RV; 0 deg for all planets (mutual nodes unknown)

elements.mean_anomaly_deg.note: no epoch in default row; deterministic spread (golden angle + seeded jitter)

state.method: Keplerian elements -> Cartesian in Jacobi order around the inner subsystem; independently published elements, NOT a coherent N-body fit

surface.equilibrium_temp_k.method: full-redistribution blackbody at the semi-major axis using summed host luminosity

appearance.note: artistic hypothesis chosen from size/temperature class; no observed surface map exists

text.en: Pulsar-white dwarf inner orbit uses literature period/eccentricity; inclination 55 deg and phase are assumed.
text.ru: Внутренняя орбита пульсар–белый карлик: период/эксцентриситет из литературы; наклон 55° и фаза приняты.

text.en: Planets without a published inclination are placed coplanar with the measured ones.
text.ru: Планеты без опубликованного наклонения размещены компланарно с измеренными.

text.en: Planets without a measured radius (RV, timing, imaging) get a mass-radius relation estimate.
text.ru: Планетам без измеренного радиуса присвоена оценка по соотношению масса–радиус.

text.en: Orbits without a published eccentricity start circular.
text.ru: Орбиты без опубликованного эксцентриситета начинаются круговыми.

text.en: Sky-plane node angles are not measured for transit/RV planets; all are set to 0, so mutual inclinations may be underestimated.
text.ru: Углы узлов в картинной плоскости не измерены для транзитных/RV планет; все приняты 0, взаимные наклоны могут быть занижены.

text.en: Planets without a transit time or periastron time get an arbitrary but fixed starting phase.
text.ru: Планетам без времени транзита/перицентра задана произвольная, но фиксированная начальная фаза.

text.en: Elements come from independently published solutions; the scene is a reconstruction, not a coherent photodynamical fit, and will not reproduce exact future transit times.
text.ru: Элементы взяты из независимо опубликованных решений; сцена — реконструкция, а не согласованный фотодинамический fit, и не воспроизведёт точные будущие транзиты.
